annotations.text: A · Sticker Bento — cream dot-grid paper, 3px ink outlines, hard offset shadows. Every tile gets its own colour and a spot illustration (piggy bank, safe, rocket, sprout…). Closest to today's layout: sidebar, hero, 4×2 tiles, trend and attention. Made-up figures.

B · Chai Buddy — the chai cup is a mascot who says the greeting out loud. Sky-blue page, a round icon rail instead of the sidebar, circular illustration badges on the tiles, net worth as one chunky segmented bar (assets) with a hatched strip for what you owe. Made-up figures.

C · Pop Poster — the loudest one. Yellow page with pink halftone, Bowlby One display type, tilted tiles, a starburst for the monthly change, comic speech bubbles for the attention list, halftone-filled bars. Navigation becomes a strip of stickers across the top. Made-up figures.

D · Money Town — the hero is a vector skyline: the bank, the investments tower with a rocket, the FD vault, the EPF tree, the house for loans and the card shop each carry a sign with their figure, under a net-worth billboard. Folder tabs for navigation, retro app windows for the tiles, and the bank trend as stacked blocks (1 block = ₹1 L). Made-up figures.
